sentence: Behind both stands the intangible logic of the productivity J-curve: complements are built, unbooked, before they pay
passage: [Brynjolfsson et al. (2021), pp. 333--334] "realizing their potential also requires large intangible investments and a fundamental rethinking of the organization of production itself. Firms must create new business processes, develop managerial experience, train workers, patch software, and build other intangibles."

gemini.overclaim: productivity J-curve: complements are built, unbooked, before they pay
gemini.note: The passage discusses the need to build intangible investments but does not explicitly mention the productivity J-curve, that they are unbooked, or the timing of when they pay off.
